part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in the 10.8.0 "state-settling" logic in `hooks/src/index.js`: when a component re-rendered during its own render (e.g. `setState` called mid-render), `handleRender` wiped every hook's committed `_args`, making `useEffect(..., [])` think its deps changed and re-queueing the effect — which ran its prior cleanup (the unexpected alert).

The fix (matching upstream Preact 10.8.1) stages hook results in `_pendingArgs`/`_pendingValue` instead of clearing committed state:
- `useEffect`/`useLayoutEffect`/`useMemo` write to pending fields; committed `_args`/`_value` are only updated on commit (`handleCommit`) or at the next successful render pass (`handleRender`)
- A same-component re-render (setState during render) now discards only the pending values, so effects from a disposed render are cancelled and committed effects are never re-run

Verified in the container: all 98 hooks tests pass (including `should cancel effects from a disposed render`, `should not rerun committed effects`, `should not commit memoization from a skipped render`), full suite is 973 passing with only one pre-existing, unrelated failure (`*Capture` focus event test, fails identically on the pristine tree), plus TS type tests pass and lint shows no new errors.
